source_name: Živé.sk
why_relevant: Leading Slovak tech news site and the named payments/technology channel for this cell — the outlet that typically covers mobile banking app releases, instant payments, QR-payment schemes and outages. Complements the financial press, which covers profit but not payment rails.

source_name: FinStat.sk — company financial profiles (Tatra banka etc.)
why_relevant: Aggregator of Slovak statutory filings (register účtovných závierok): per-IČO pages with revenue, profit and filed financial statements for each bank entity. Structured, machine-readable-ish, and independent of whether the bank issues a press release — a hard baseline against which media-reported numbers can be validated.

source_name: Tatra banka — Výročné správy / finančné ukazovatele archive
why_relevant: Surfaced repeatedly as the top hit for sk-language 'hospodársky výsledok' queries: a stable PDF archive of annual reports and Pillar-3-style disclosure documents, with predictable filenames per year. The reference document set that media commentary is derived from.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — komentáre, publikácie, tlačové konferencie
why_relevant: The aggregate sector-profit numbers that Slovak media report ('banky zarobili X miliónov') originate in NBS statistics and its Správa o finančnej stabilite / Makroprudenciálny komentár. Tracking NBS release dates predicts when the media wave of earnings commentary will appear, which is exactly the date-stamping function this cell needs.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — sector commentary quoted in media
why_relevant: Trade body whose statements frame the Slovak earnings narrative (e.g. 'zisky bánk rastú len na prvý pohľad', capital-competitiveness argument) and are recycled by SITA/TASR on results days. A pointer to industry positioning on the bank levy and profitability debate.

source_name: Interez.sk — banking results roundups
why_relevant: Popular-audience Slovak news site that publishes comparative roundups after the reporting season ('banks published their profits, who was the mover of the year'), which conveniently list several banks' figures in one place. Low editorial authority but useful as a discovery/roundup pointer.

source_name: Startitup.sk — biznis/banking coverage
why_relevant: High-traffic Slovak lifestyle/business portal that reliably rewrites NBS quarterly bank-profit statistics for a mass audience, often within hours. Useful as a fast, free change-detection tripwire even though it is not authoritative.

source_name: Kryptomagazín.sk — Slovak bank profit rankings
why_relevant: Marginal but real: publishes 'TOP 5 slovenských bánk' profit rankings compiled from published results. Recorded for completeness of the sk-language media map; low credibility and should never be cited numerically.

source_name: Moody's Ratings — issuer page, Slovenská sporiteľňa, a.s.
why_relevant: Rating agency issuer page carrying deposit/issuer/senior ratings, outlooks and (paywalled) credit opinions for Slovakia's largest bank; restates asset quality, capital and funding metrics that the bank's own PR does not headline.

source_name: Moody's Ratings — rating news / rating actions feed (Slovak issuers)
why_relevant: Free press-release layer announcing multi-bank Slovak rating actions (e.g. affirmations/outlook changes across three Slovak banks at once) — the cheapest reliable trigger signal for SK banking-sector credit developments.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — regulatory disclosure / research articles on Slovak banks
why_relevant: S&P rates Tatra banka and VÚB; regulatory-disclosure articles publish rating rationale and key ratios free of charge, and S&P has taken upgrades on SK banks tied to improving economic/industry risk.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings — Banking Industry Country Risk Assessment (BICRA) update, incl. Slovakia
why_relevant: Monthly BICRA table gives Slovakia's banking-system group score plus economic and industry risk scores — a compact, comparable, independent read on SK banking-system risk that no issuer publishes about itself.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa — Ratings page (Investors)
why_relevant: Issuer-maintained mirror of agency ratings (Moody's, Fitch, covered bond ratings) — free and structured, useful as a low-friction proxy when agency pages are paywalled; must be read as issuer-curated.

source_name: VÚB Banka — investor presentation / covered bond investor materials
why_relevant: Covered-bond investor decks compile rating-agency assessments, cover-pool asset quality and funding metrics in one file — analyst-grade numbers issued for a rating/investor audience rather than press.

source_name: The Covered Bond Report — Slovak covered bond rating coverage
why_relevant: Trade press that tracks agency rating actions on Slovak covered bond programmes and legal-regime changes — a specialist secondary layer that explains rating rationale in plain text when agency reports are gated.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Article IV consultation reports
why_relevant: Annual independent country note with a dedicated financial-sector section: concentration (top-5 ≈ 3/4 of assets), foreign-ownership share, profitability, buffers, RRE vulnerabilities and macroprudential settings — validation data no SK bank publishes about the system.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) technical notes
why_relevant: Deep, infrequent (once-a-decade-ish) technical notes on systemic risk, stress testing and the macroprudential framework — the single richest independent quantitative dossier on the SK banking system.

source_name: EBA — EU-wide transparency exercise (bank-by-bank data)
why_relevant: Annual, standardised bank-level capital, RWA, leverage, sovereign exposure and asset-quality data drawn from supervisory reporting — the strongest cross-checkable dataset against SK banks' own annual reports, with interactive tools and downloadable files.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision — Supervisory Banking Statistics + ECB Data Portal SUP dataset
why_relevant: Quarterly SSM aggregates by country; note that SK has no significant institution at the highest level of consolidation, so SK appears mainly via less-significant-institution and host-country cuts — an important structural caveat for any SK benchmarking.

source_name: Deloitte CZ/SK — Banking & Capital Markets research hub
why_relevant: The CZ/SK Deloitte member-firm hub is the entry point to SK-relevant recurring studies (Digital Banking Maturity, CE banking sector commentary) and to Slovak-language press releases; consultancy-produced benchmarking of SK banks' digital channels that banks themselves do not publish.

source_name: Deloitte — Digital Banking Maturity (CE benchmark incl. Slovak banks)
why_relevant: Biennial mystery-shopper benchmark scoring ~1,000 digital functionalities across web, internet banking and mobile for hundreds of banks including SK — the closest thing to an objective functional scorecard of Slovak retail banks' channels.

source_name: Deloitte — CEE Banking M&A Study (annual)
why_relevant: Annual study covering ~16 CEE countries with a Slovakia chapter: ownership, consolidation, profitability and asset quality; the standard reference for SK banking M&A and market-structure shifts.

source_name: KPMG Slovensko — audit & financial services practice site (sk/en)
why_relevant: KPMG is a statutory auditor of major Slovak banks (e.g. Tatra banka, mBank SK branch, UniCredit historically); its SK site carries local surveys, CEO/CFO outlooks and regulatory commentary in Slovak, and points to the audit-firm-bank mapping.

source_name: Deloitte Slovensko — audit service page / local press room (sk)
why_relevant: Slovak-language audit practice page and Deloitte Audit s.r.o. Bratislava entity, which signs auditor reports appearing in SK bank filings; useful to attribute opinions and to catch SK-language sector commentary.

source_name: PwC Slovensko — Bankovníctvo, poisťovníctvo a kapitálové trhy
why_relevant: PwC's Slovak banking/insurance industry page is the entry point for SK-language advisory commentary on banking regulation, risk and payments; useful for early signals on regulatory-driven bank spend even when no formal survey is published.

source_name: NBS — Správa o finančnej stabilite (Financial Stability Report)
why_relevant: Semi-annual national aggregator/validator: sector profitability, mortgage-driven interest income, capital and liquidity position and stress-test outcomes; the domestic counterpart against which agency and Big Four claims about SK banks should be checked. Published in Slovak and English.

source_name: Banky.sk — Rating bánk (aggregated SK bank ratings)
why_relevant: Slovak-language aggregator page listing agency ratings per SK bank plus rating-change news items — a cheap SK-language tripwire that surfaces rating actions which otherwise sit behind agency paywalls.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — Slovak bank profiles with credit-rating sections
why_relevant: Pan-European bank-profile aggregator that compiles ratings, ownership and balance-sheet basics per Slovak bank — convenient for building the SK bank universe and spotting which agencies actually rate which institution.
